Important Details!

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.26.0″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”|600|||||||” text_text_color=”#FEFEFE” positioning=”relative” horizontal_offset=”65px” width=”70%” max_width=”100%” module_alignment=”center” inline_fonts=”Jim Nightshade” global_colors_info=”{}”]

  • Fair Chase – Viejo Creek Ranch is a low fence ranch. There is no guarantee that you will harvest an animal. This is real hunting at it’s finest. If you do not harvest an animal, you may extend your stay for $250/person/day or you can book another trip at a discounted rate. We will try our best to put you on an animal but we cannot promise that it will happen.
  • Semi-guided hunts – Hunters will be given a tour of the ranch and hunting locations. Transportation will not be provided on your hunt to and from blinds and hunting locations unless specified.  All vehicles and ATV’s traveling back and forth to hunting areas must be approved before arrival.
  • Meals – Meals will not be included in this package but may be added upon request for an additional fee. Please request this at the time of booking.
  • Guests – Non-Hunting Guests will be charged a fee per night.
